title: GEORGE SOROS'S SOROS FUND JUST UPDATED ITS STOCK PORTFOLIO
author: tickeron_community
selftext:
Tickeron AI uncovered the moves nobody's talking about in the latest  
Soros Fund Management 13F. Intel $INTC was multiplied about 28 times  
into a $340M top stock, and Meta $META was lifted 595.74%. The filing  
also shows a $670M put on the energy ETF $XLE, after they added  
444.92%, plus a new $328M put on $XOP. They sold out of Electronic  
Arts $EA, and cut Apple $AAPL by 25.66% and Nvidia $NVDA by 19.33%.
